# xcler.dev — Digital Agency (Germany / DACH + Benelux + US markets we serve)

XCLER is a Berlin-based digital agency. We offer web development, app development, WordPress & Shopify solutions, workflow automation, and AI chatbots & agents for businesses in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and the United States (California, Florida, Chicago).

## Company
- Name: XCLER
- Website: https://xcler.dev
- Primary market: Germany / DACH (Berlin)
- Also serve (remote): Netherlands & Belgium (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, The Hague, Brussels) — no fake local offices
- Also serve (remote): California, Florida, Chicago — no fake local offices
- Email: hello@xcler.dev

## What we offer (existing services only)
1. Web Development / Next.js frontend architecture
2. App Development / Custom SaaS
3. WordPress & Shopify / Headless commerce
4. WordPress development Germany
5. Shopify development Germany
6. Workflow Automation (Make.com, n8n, Zapier, GoHighLevel)
7. AI Chatbots & Agents (RAG, LLMs, call agents) — our AI engineering focus

## AI engineering & automation (priority)
We build production RAG systems, AI chatbots, autonomous agents, and workflow automation with Make.com and n8n. We integrate LLMs into support, lead qualification, and internal operations for B2B teams in Germany, DACH, Benelux, and the US markets we serve.
